text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, what a relief. If it's my forehead, 
Trainer-chan won't be able to see—

text_block_list.name: Beauty Product Commercial
text_block_list.text:
—"Rough skin means rough times with your 
crush! Skincare is common sense for 
romance☆"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Maya has to go... ...I have to go buy 
this!

Faced with skin troubles—a maiden's 
ultimate crisis— Mayano Top Gun fell into 
a total panic...
